options.text: When moving air carries the light chaff farther while the heavier mustard seeds fall closer.
When he takes the mixture into a closed room with no moving air.
When the heavier mustard seeds travel farther in the breeze and the light chaff falls closer.
When a breeze blows so the lighter chaff and heavier seeds separate by how far each travels.

stem:
Rohit helps clean mustard seeds mixed with light chaff outdoors while a breeze blows across the courtyard.

Which claims correctly say when winnowing can separate this mixture? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Winnowing needs moving air so lighter chaff travels farther and heavier seeds fall closer. No air, or reversing which part travels farther, misses the method.
